claims.quote: Daisy's ricefish, Oryzias woworae, is known only from a single stream on the island of Muna, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Oryzias woworae was described in 2010 and is found only on Muna Island, off southeastern Sulawesi, Indonesia.
